mappings.rationale: Uraian describes an integrated cultivation chain for narcotic plants and prohibited medicinal (obat terlarang) crops — land preparation, planting, maintenance, harvesting, and post-harvest activity carried out as a single continuous sequence, not a standalone-planting-only class. Both BPS Vol.2 crosswalk directions confirm this is a genuine code-preserving continuation, not a coincidental title echo: Lampiran 5 (2020->2025, p.132) shows KBLI2020 01287 'Pertanian Tanaman Narkotika dan Tanaman Obat Terlarang' mapping to KBLI2025 01287 with the identical title, and Lampiran 10 (2025->2020, p.326) shows the reverse row confirming the same sole pairing — 01287 appears exactly once in each table with no other source/target row referencing it, i.e. no split or merge. Confidence in this being a real static mapping (rather than a table artifact) is reinforced by contrast with the immediate neighborhood: the sheet correctly captures genuine renumbers/splits right next to it (KBLI2020 01283 'Pertanian Cabai' moved to KBLI2025 01138; KBLI2025 01283 'Pertanian Pala' was newly carved out of KBLI2020 01289's basket code), so the surrounding rows prove the crosswalk is discriminating real change from non-change, and 01287 sits firmly on the non-change side. canonical.json's own status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG' corroborates this as a direct 1:1 continuation.

payload.notes: Evidence completeness: canonical.json read + evidence-index.json cross-checked (7 files, sha256-tracked). Both crosswalk PNGs (Lampiran 5 p.132 and Lampiran 10 p.326) visually inspected — bidirectional confirmation of a sole 01287<->01287 pairing, digits read directly off the rendered table image (not OCR/pdftotext). pp28/ absent: recorded via pp28/ABSENT.json — the code-specific PP28 lampiran search returned verdict='absent' after hunting 21 source files / 11,208 pages, so no PP28-vintage lampiran row exists for 01287 in this vault snapshot; treated as absent, not guessed. oss/ layer: detail.json, relasi.json, umku.json present (not read in full, not needed for the crosswalk adjudication question); oss/ruang_lingkup is the only missing OSS endpoint (recorded via oss/ABSENT.json, status 404 from OSS gateway) and does not bear on crosswalk or licensing-provenance. licensing_inherits=false on two independent grounds: (1) canonical.json's own _l1_source='OSS_RBA_2025_id_version_fff4053d' and _source_relabeled note explicitly state the licensing content (perizinan/persyaratan/kewajiban/sanksi across all 8 per_skala rows) is OSS-RBA-2025-vintage, not carried over from a KBLI-2020 PP28 lampiran; (2) the pp28/ABSENT.json independently confirms no PP28 lampiran evidence exists for this code at all in the vault, so there is nothing 2020-vintage to inherit from — no D2 image-verified row extraction is warranted for this code."

reasons: Independently re-derived crosswalk from both PNGs before reading proposal: lampiran5 (KBLI2020->2025) row 01287->01287 identical title 'Pertanian Tanaman Narkotika dan Tanaman Obat Terlarang'; lampiran10 (2025->2020) confirms the reverse pairing bidirectionally. No other row in either visible table references 01287 (adjacent 01286/01289 rows checked) -> confirms ONE_TO_ONE, no split/merge.

Spot-checked the proposal's two neighborhood-corroboration claims against the images and both are accurate verbatim: 01283 Pertanian Cabai -> 01138 (lampiran5), and 01283 Pertanian Pala carved from 01289's basket (lampiran10).
canonical.json uraian text and status_mapping='MATCH_LANGSUNG' independently confirmed to match the proposal's rationale.

licensing_inherits=false independently corroborated: canonical.json's _source_relabeled note explicitly states content is OSS-RBA-2025-vintage (not a 2020 PP28 carry-over), and pp28/ABSENT.json independently confirms verdict='absent' with files_scanned=21 entries and pages_scanned_total=11208, matching the proposal's cited figures exactly.
oss/ABSENT.json independently confirms the single missing OSS endpoint is ruang_lingkup (404), matching the proposal's claim.

One factual discrepancy found (non-substantive): the proposal's notes claim evidence-index.json tracks '7 files, sha256-tracked' but the file actually contains 8 tracked entries (verified via python json.load len()=8 and `find -type f`). This is a clerical off-by-one in the notes narrative and does not affect the crosswalk mapping or licensing-inheritance determination, both of which were independently reproduced and match.
